distillation.intro1: Each Dyane creation is born from a rare standard: achieving a balance few approach, and which one recognises immediately.
distillation.intro2: Crafted in France, in the heart of Vaucluse, our cuvées come to life in a territory where light, matter and time shape every detail.
distillation.origine_titre: THE ORIGIN: A NOBLE INGREDIENT, A LAND OF EXCELLENCE
distillation.origine_p1: We exclusively select raw ingredients: fresh ginger, whole vanilla pods, citrus zests, to preserve the purity of aromas.
distillation.origine_p2: Each element is chosen for its ability to express itself with precision, without artifice or correction.
distillation.origine_p3: This rigour in selection forms the foundation of every cuvée.
distillation.elaboration_titre: THE ELABORATION: WINE ALCOHOL AS FOUNDATION
distillation.elaboration_p1: At the heart of each creation lies a fundamental element: a wine alcohol of exceptional purity.
distillation.elaboration_p2: Derived from the transformation of wine, this alcohol is distinguished by its finesse, aromatic neutrality and ability to sublimate the ingredients it hosts.
distillation.elaboration_p3: It acts as a revealer, allowing notes of ginger, vanilla or citrus to unfold with precision and elegance.
distillation.elaboration_p4: Infusions are carried out slowly, over controlled durations, to extract every nuance without ever rushing the matter.
distillation.elaboration_p5: This long process yields an aromatic depth and stability that give the cuvée its character and signature.
distillation.signature_titre: THE SIGNATURE: A MASTERED SENSORY EXPERIENCE
distillation.signature_p1: Each recipe is conceived as a composition: a frank attack, an expressive heart, a persistent finish.
distillation.signature_p2: The balance between power and finesse is adjusted to the millilitre, until a rare harmony is achieved.
distillation.signature_p3: Nothing is left to chance: neither the texture, nor the structure, nor the way aromas evolve throughout the tasting.
distillation.signature_p4: At Dyane, the cocktail is no longer a mix. It is a liquid work of art.
distillation.citation: « EACH DYANE CUVÉE IS CONCEIVED AS A SELF-EVIDENT TRUTH: A BALANCE SO RIGHT IT ASSERTS ITSELF FROM THE VERY FIRST SIP. »
distillation.citation_titre: HEAD OF RECIPE DESIGN AT DYANE

experiences.intro1: Dyane Paris is a French Liquid Art House dedicated to reinterpreting exclusive cocktail flavours in the form of refined spirits.
experiences.intro2: Its purpose is clear: to preserve mastery of taste, gesture and time in a world dominated by industrialisation. Each creation stems from a deliberately contained production, conducted with method and discernment.
experiences.mesure_p1: The Maison operates against the logic of volume. Production is never standardised.
experiences.mesure_p2: It is defined according to the nature of the project, the identity of the venue, the partner's requirements. Each batch is precisely monitored, from blending to bottling. Consistency prevails over cadence. Precision over quantity.
experiences.mesure_p3: Each series is produced to order, within a controlled timeline. This approach guarantees the integrity of aromas, the coherence of blends and the exact adaptation of formats, from 70 cL to 12 L. Production remains calibrated to never become large-scale mechanised.
experiences.perso_p1: Personalisation is one of the most accomplished expressions of the Maison's expertise. Each project is carefully studied to ensure perfect coherence between contents and container.
experiences.perso_p2: Recipes can be adjusted in their balance, intensity and aromatic signature, to meet the most specific expectations.
experiences.perso_p3: The container is developed with the same level of exigence. Formats, finishes, artistic interventions: every detail is conceived as an essential component of the whole.
experiences.perso_p4: It commits the Maison to a process of listening and precision in order to accompany the demands of our most exacting partners.
experiences.ancrages_titre: TWO LOCATIONS, ONE STANDARD OF EXCELLENCE
experiences.ancrages_p1: The Maison operates from two production sites in France.
experiences.ancrages_p2: In Île-de-France, at the heart of a world-class cultural and hospitality ecosystem, where event productions and bespoke series are conducted. In the Avignon region, a territory of artisanal tradition, dedicated to blending and the stability of infusions.
experiences.ancrages_p3: Two complementary locations, guided by the same discipline.
experiences.citation: "MY COLLABORATION WITH DYANE WAS BORN FROM MUTUAL RESPECT AND A SHARED AMBITION: TO OFFER PREMIUM COCKTAILS THAT COMBINE AUTHENTICITY, ELEGANCE AND MODERNITY. EACH SPIRIT IS CONCEIVED AND BLENDED WITH GOLDSMITH PRECISION TO SUBLIMATE RAW INGREDIENTS AND REVEAL THE PURITY OF AROMAS."
